purpose: Primary-source provenance for the Rev A electrical design. The SHA-bound JLCPCB assembly mapping is config/jlcpcb-parts.json; supplier stock remains volatile and must be rechecked before ordering.

parts.evidence: WROOM-1 module with PCB antenna; supply range 3.0–3.6 V.
Revision B4 product drawing; J1 land pattern was verified against the recommended layout and is SHA-recorded in config/footprint-provenance.json.
10-pin Plug-of-Nails footprint with explicit keepout and solder-mask constraints.
Two-line, low-capacitance USB ESD protector in SOT-666. The verified pin map is 1/6 = I/O1 (D-), 3/4 = I/O2 (D+), 2 = GND, 5 = VBUS.
3.3 V fixed-output, 1.1 MHz, 2 A synchronous buck in TSOT26; BST-to-SW capacitor is 100 nF.

4.7 uH XGL4030 shielded inductor. Official data specifies 3.2 A at 20% inductance drop and 6.6 A for 40°C rise; the matching JLCPCB assembly listing is C7159276. Footprint authority is KiCad Inductor_SMD:L_Coilcraft_XxL4030.
16-pin TSSOP four-channel SPDT switch, bidirectional signal paths, and powered-off protection through 3.6 V.
Active-low open-drain supervisor in 3-pin SOT-23 with fixed delay option.
60 V N-channel SOT-23 MOSFET; electrical data-sheet and pinout must be attached before footprint freeze.
30 V P-channel SOT-23 MOSFET; source/drain orientation is a release-critical check.
Ultra-low capacitance unidirectional ESD diode in SOD882.
5 V standoff unidirectional TVS in DO-214AA/SMB; assembly mapping C83333.
750 mA hold, 16 V resettable PTC in 1206; assembly mapping C371166.
Top-actuated tactile switch matching the Panasonic EVQPUJ/EVQPUA land pattern; assembly mapping C2936858.
Specified yellow-green 0603 power indicator; assembly mapping C125094.
Specified blue 0603 status indicator; assembly mapping C125096.

release_notes: config/jlcpcb-parts.json maps every SMD position to an exact MPN and LCSC number and is bound to the released board SHA-256.
J2 is a no-component Tag-Connect footprint; J3 and J4 are through-hole headers and are intentionally absent from the SMD assembly BOM/CPL.

PESD3V3U1UL,315 (C552530) and EVQPUJ02K (C2936858) were out of stock at the 2026-08-09 review. Do not silently substitute them; recheck stock or perform a reviewed alternate-part change before ordering.
Always inspect JLCPCB's placement preview and polarity/orientation warnings before approving an order.
